_meta.description: Daily FAO-56 reference evapotranspiration (ETo), rainfall and temperature per Haryana district centroid.
_meta.source: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ERA5-based reanalysis). Free, no API key, CC-BY 4.0.
_meta.usage: Crop water demand ETc = ETo x Kc. Kc per crop and growth stage lives in crops.json.
_meta.geometry: Values are sampled at each district's area-weighted centroid, not averaged over the polygon.
